tbesh_html:
1) to stoop, bend, incline
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to stoop, bend
1a2) to incline, tip
1b) (Piel) to tip over

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), i.e. (figuratively) depopulate; by implication, to imprison or conquer; (reflexive) to lie down (for coitus)
